title: Family event planning (party, reunion, holiday) with budget tracking
description: Plan vendors, venue, and timeline for a family event, track the plan against budget, and replan automatically if it runs over.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: family-event-planning
  title: Family event planning (party, reunion, holiday) with budget tracking
  description: Plan vendors, venue, and timeline for a family event, track the plan against budget, and replan automatically if it runs over.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a vendor, venue, and timeline plan for a family event that fits the stated budget, replanning up to two times if the draft plan exceeds it.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 3, onFailure: stop, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Event details and budget
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The event type, date, guest count, budget, and any vendor or venue preferences. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: vendor-venue-researcher
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Vendor and venue researcher
      role: Practical researcher of event vendors and venues.
      prompt: Research vendor and venue options that fit the family's stated event type, guest count, date, and preferences. List estimated prices for each option and note availability considerations. Flag any option that looks likely to strain the stated budget.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, supply-chain-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: budget-timeline-planner
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Budget and timeline planner
      role: Practical planner for event budgets and timelines.
      prompt: Draft a line-item budget and a planning timeline for the family's event based on the stated guest count, date, and budget. Show running totals against the stated budget and flag any line items that push the plan over budget.
      capabilities: { skills: [finance-analysis, operations-planning], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: plan-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel vendor and budget planning
      config: { members: [vendor-venue-researcher, budget-timeline-planner], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: merge-plan
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge vendor, venue, and budget plan
      config: { aggregation: merge }
    - id: budget-check
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Budget compliance check
      role: Independent evaluator of whether the plan fits the stated budget.
      prompt: Check whether the merged plan's total estimated cost fits within the family's stated budget. Return score, passed, and reasons, listing specific line items that caused any overage.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 1.0 }
    - id: replanner
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Budget replanner
      role: Practical replanner that trims an over-budget event plan.
      prompt: Given the plan and the specific overage reasons from the budget check, revise the vendor, venue, or timeline choices to bring the total estimated cost within the stated budget while preserving the family's stated priorities. Show the updated line-item totals.
      capabilities: { skills: [finance-analysis, operations-planning], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: replan-loop
      kind: loop
      name: Replan until within budget
      config: { body: [budget-check, replanner], exitCondition: "budget-check.passed == true", maxIterations: 2, onExhausted: warn }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Final event plan with budget status
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: plan-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: plan-group, to: merge-plan, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: merge-plan, to: budget-check, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: budget-check, to: replanner, kind: control, condition: "passed == false" }
    - { id: e4-pass, from: budget-check, to: result, kind: control, condition: "passed == true" }
    - { id: e5, from: replanner, to: replan-loop, kind: dependency }
    - { id: e6, from: replan-loop, to: result, kind: control, condition: loop_exit }
    - { id: e6-exhausted, from: replan-loop, to: result, kind: control, condition: loop_exhausted }
